experiment: Random real-document transfer smoke test, no gold

selection.method: uniform random.Random(seed).choice over two other versioned real DOCX
selection.reason_pool: Catanzaro already used extensively; dedicated Labirinto excluded

setup_correction.reason: The drawn bando has no stored project. Global SOURCE requires an existing authorized workspace.

metrics.scope: complete small document corpus, proposal + local audit only

assessment.observed_failure_stage: Model response: empty facts/conditions/bindings/fields, not local validation rejection.
assessment.mechanism: The sparse schema has no minimum map size; TASK instructs omission for unsupported/unknown conditions. Empty output parses; unassigned positions are retained as REVIEW_REQUIRED.
assessment.cause_not_established: No internal reasoning was returned. One call cannot establish why all records were omitted; no truncation/provider/schema error was reported.
assessment.temporal_limit: Historical bando and simulated company SOURCE from 2026: this is a transfer test, not proof of eligibility at the bando date.

manual_checks.observation: Signer name and personal tax code unassigned. Company tax code and administrator identity do not automatically prove these values.

Engineering-company branch entirely unassigned. SOURCE -43/-44/-30 contain denomination, address, VAT, phone and PEC, but SOURCE data presence does not alone prove branch/representation or each exact destination.
No membership number assigned. Director's 8421 (-45/-32) cannot automatically fill declarant/architect/agronom fields.
Communication PEC unassigned. A company PEC is present (-44/-30); no proposal or independently verified choice/applicability was produced.
Signature remains unassigned and structurally write-protected.

checks.not_checked: No pre-call fingerprints were acquired for other tables. No browser/chat/session workflow was exercised.
